mission.statement: Turn the MVP ingest stubs into a real pipeline that ingests a LinkedIn CV PDF, extracts its rendered text, and strips it into a structured LinkedInProfile Pydantic model (mirroring docs/archives/Profile-Test.pdf) that downstream agent nodes consume.
mission.terminal_signal: Given docs/archives/Profile-Test.pdf, the /analyze upload no longer corrupts the bytes; the strip node produces an AgentState.profile matching the LinkedInProfile schema (name, headline, contact, summary, top_skills, languages, certifications, experiences, education); the graph still streams to completion.

scope_note: This is the real implementation of master decomposition.json#T6.1 (ingest+strip). Emitted to a separate file to avoid clobbering the project-wide DAG.

goals.title: Structured LinkedInProfile model
goals.rationale: Defines the typed shape the stripped PDF becomes, mirroring the LinkedIn export; CVProfile becomes a downstream reduction of it.
goals.completion_signal: `python -c 'from app.schemas import LinkedInProfile'` resolves and validates a hand-built sample.

goals.title: Real PDF text extraction
goals.rationale: Replaces the utf-8 decode that corrupts PDF bytes with a real extractor so ingest actually reads the file.

goals.title: Deterministic strip into LinkedInProfile
goals.rationale: The strip node turns extracted text into the structured profile carried on AgentState.
goals.completion_signal: strip_node populates state.profile from the sample text; contact.email and >=1 experience are present.

goals.title: End-to-end wiring
goals.rationale: Router reads PDF bytes robustly and analyze consumes the structured profile when present.
goals.completion_signal: POST /analyze stores decoded CV text (not mojibake); graph run over the sample yields extracted_skills seeded from profile.top_skills.

goals.title: Validation
goals.rationale: Confirm the full path against the canonical sample PDF.
goals.completion_signal: Ad-hoc run over Profile-Test.pdf prints a fully-populated LinkedInProfile without errors.

tasks.title: Add LinkedInProfile + submodels to schemas/profile.py and export them
tasks.rationale: Single source of truth for the stripped-PDF shape; keeps existing CVProfile as the reduction.
tasks.acceptance_test: `from app.schemas import LinkedInProfile` resolves; model_validate on a hand-built dict succeeds.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Pydantic v2 DTOs live under apps/api/src/app/schemas and are re-exported via schemas/__init__.py.

tasks.title: Add pypdf dependency and agent/pdf_parser.py
tasks.rationale: extract_text_from_pdf(bytes)->str using pypdf, tolerant of parse errors.
tasks.acceptance_test: extract_text_from_pdf(sample_bytes) contains 'Raphael Motta'; invalid bytes return ''.
tasks.sdd_snippet: strip — extract clean text from CV (PDF/DOCX/TXT). Allowed backend deps managed via uv.

tasks.title: Add agent/linkedin_parser.py deterministic section parser
tasks.sdd_snippet: strip node structures extracted text; deterministic, offline, testable.

tasks.title: Add profile field to AgentState and populate it in strip_node
tasks.rationale: Carries the structured profile through the graph for downstream nodes.
tasks.acceptance_test: After strip_node, state.profile is a dict with name/contact/experiences keys.
tasks.sdd_snippet: AgentState { user_id, raw_cv_text, raw_description, extracted_skills, ... }; strip extracts clean text from CV.

tasks.title: Read PDF bytes in /analyze via pdf_parser (fix utf-8 corruption)
tasks.rationale: Ingest must decode PDFs by extracting text, not utf-8 decoding raw bytes.
tasks.acceptance_test: Uploading the sample PDF stores readable text in the analysis request (contains 'Experience'), not mojibake.
tasks.sdd_snippet: POST /analyze accepts multipart form (name/phone/email/description/CV file); CV files are ephemeral.

tasks.title: Consume structured profile in analyze_node when present
tasks.rationale: Seed extracted_skills from profile.top_skills/technologies before falling back to heuristics.
tasks.acceptance_test: With state.profile set, extracted_skills.technologies includes items from top_skills.
tasks.sdd_snippet: analyze — extract skills, technologies, years of experience, domain areas.

tasks.title: Validate full extract+parse against Profile-Test.pdf
tasks.rationale: Confirms the canonical sample flows through extraction and parsing with no errors.
tasks.acceptance_test: Ad-hoc run prints a populated LinkedInProfile (name, contact.email, >=3 experiences, education) with no exception.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Given a sample CV, the graph streams progress and returns structured output.
